newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish forest industry must cut costs - consultants.
newsitem.headline: Swedish forest industry must cut costs - consultants.

text.p: Sweden's forestry industry must cut costs and lift processing value to keep up with increasing competition from other countries, particularly from southeast Asia, a conference was told on Tuesday.
"The forestry industry in Sweden will find it more difficult on the costs side on account of competition from the tropics (southeast Asia)," Jaakko Poyry from the Poyry Consulting Group said.
"We must raise processing values all the time."
Fellow consultant Rainer Haggblom said Sweden's forestry industry will need more electricity in the future.
"The forestry industry in Sweden will be more energy intensive and more money is needed for research, all in an effort to raise processing value," he said.
He also pointed out the importance of increased cooperation between the forestry industry and the chemical industry as part of synergies within the European Union.
